acquisition_rule: Pin the installed minigrid package version and wheel/source SHA-256 before import. If the registered environment or source semantics differ from the authority page, HOLD without version substitution.

system.state: complete environment state including grid objects/states, agent position/direction, carried object, step count, and termination flag
system.transition: exact deterministic environment step for official actions 0..6
observation_maps: O_full: exact complete environment state encoding
O_native: official direction plus 7x7x3 image encoding, excluding mission text because it is constant
system.admissible_actions: The official Discrete(7) interface; effective-action support is the subset whose step changes full state or terminates. No learned policy is used.
system.representation: left-right grid reflection with agent direction, object coordinates, and actions 0(left)/1(right) relabeled; actions 2..6 fixed

frozen_domain: Exhaustive reachable-state closure for each official 5x5 layout instance exposed by the pinned environment generation. If seeded generation produces more than one layout, each seed is a separate predeclared stratum; no favorable seed selection.
frozen_checks: enumerate every reachable full state under actions 0..6 until closure
build native-observation fibers and test target constancy
test all official-action and effective-action reachability supports
construct reflected layouts mechanically and prove state/action/target closure
compare every reflected transition and shortest-path distance
emit the first mismatch under lexicographic (layout,state,action) order
positive_prediction: For a reflected layout pair, exact full-state/action relabeling commutes and shortest-path search can be reused.
negative_controls: reflect state coordinates without swapping left/right actions; commutation must fail
use O_native fibers without direction; target constancy or one-step support must fail somewhere if such a fiber exists, otherwise report NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE_IN_DOMAIN
kill_criteria: any unmatched transition, terminal flag, or shortest-path distance
negative control fails to fail where its antecedent fiber exists
reflection requires modifying environment physics rather than relabeling
retry_rule: No alternate grid size, wrapper, or seed selected after observing a failure. Localize and return HOLD.
